convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown indicator name '2MoHLC_' and external .mqh library 'TradeAlgorithms.mqh'. Both require manual Python reimplementation of the custom indicator logic and trade management functions.

other_exits: CloudColor mode: long position closed when UpValue < DnValue (cloud turns bearish)
CloudColor mode: short position closed when UpValue > DnValue (cloud turns bullish)
Breakdown mode: long position closed when Close falls below MathMin(UpValue, DnValue) (cloud lower boundary)
Breakdown mode: short position closed when Close rises above MathMax(UpValue, DnValue) (cloud upper boundary)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM < 0: fixed lot size = abs(MM); MM > 0: deposit fraction = MM

custom_logic_notes: Two operating modes selectable via Mode enum: (1) CloudColor - signals on cloud color change (UpValue/DnValue crossover); (2) Breakdown - signals on price breaking through the cloud boundaries (MathMax/MathMin of UpValue and DnValue). Entry signals use 2-bar lookback: current bar[SignalBar] vs previous bar[SignalBar+1] to detect crossovers/breakouts. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the last closed bar. Trade management (open/close) is handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup. LoadHistory() called for bar data synchronization.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement 2MoHLC_ custom indicator (likely a dual-moving-average cloud indicator on OHLC data with two periods 24 and 48). Two signal modes need separate implementations: CloudColor (crossover of two MA lines) and Breakdown (price vs cloud envelope). Must also reimplement trade management functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose with position sizing logic (deposit fraction vs fixed lot). The signal detection uses 2-bar comparison pattern (bar[1] vs bar[0] relative to SignalBar) for crossover/breakout detection. New bar guard must be implemented. The MM parameter has dual behavior: negative values = fixed lot size (abs value), positive values = deposit fraction.
